status: Closed — historical phantom-index blocker eliminated by canonical live-index ownership snapshot; re-verified 2026-09-02
area: pre-close blocks close on a foreign-active staged path that is not staged and whose task is done
finding: taskflow pre-close reports ATM_INDEX_FOREIGN_ACTIVE_STAGED for .atm/history/task-events/ATM-GOV-0351/2026-08-12T07-38-25-379Z-close-43d04588a9dc.json. That path is not in the index, not in HEAD, and not in the working tree — git ls-files --error-unmatch rejects it outright — and ATM-GOV-0351 is status done with its claim released, so it is not an active task either. The blocker is therefore wrong on both halves of its own name, and it is the last thing standing between a fully delivered card and close. The sanctioned route past it, git lease stage-override, cannot be granted because the lease demands that its path set exactly match the live foreign-active staged entries, and this path is in no live set.
expectedBehavior: The foreign-entry inventory must be derived from the live index at the moment of the check, and 'active' must mean the owning task actually holds a claim. An entry that git does not know about cannot block a close, and a task that is done and released owns nothing. If a stale inventory is being cached somewhere, the cache must be invalidated by the same commit that removed the entry.
evidenceOrRepro: At HEAD 88230861e, git diff --cached --name-status lists seven entries, none of them under ATM-GOV-0351/, and git ls-files --stage | grep ATM-GOV-0351 returns 42 unrelated clean entries. .atm/history/task-events/ATM-GOV-0351/ contains no file with that timestamp. .atm/history/tasks/ATM-GOV-0351.json reports status done, claim released. pre-close for ATM-GOV-0360 nonetheless returns exactly one blocker, unexpectedStagedTasks, naming that path. A grep of .atm/runtime for the filename returns nothing, so the source of the phantom entry is not an obvious runtime cache and needs tracing.
followUp: Resolved by 1059a793c (TASK-ERR-0008), which unified close and lease ownership through the canonical live-index provider. Re-verified on 2026-09-02: git-index-close-isolation, git-index-override-lease-snapshot-consistency, and planning-index-released-residue-parity all pass. Close-window inspection derives unexpected paths from git diff --cached at the moment of evaluation; an absent path cannot become foreign-active. No frozen-runner publication or task-card closeout is claimed by this backlog-only closure.
